message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files directly with pd.read_csv and checks only for file existence, but performs no schema, dtype, or value-range validation on the loaded data.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from local filesystem paths with no remote fetching, so there is no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check against any remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data loading code reads CSV files directly without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on the training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The model path is constructed and used without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; no integrity verification is performed before loading the serialized model.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks label distribution, class balance, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, gradient anomaly detection, activation analysis, or any other backdoor defense implemented in the visible code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or stress-test routines are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate train/validation/test files are loaded, there is no hashing, signing, or other integrity verification of evaluation data, and no mechanism to enforce isolation between training and test sets programmatically.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path uses argparse and eval() on user-supplied strings (e.g., eval(init_args.data_loader), eval(init_args.model_name)) with no shape, range, or schema validation on incoming data before it reaches the model.

No detected output bounds checks: The evaluate_method computes metrics on predictions but performs no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks on the raw model output values before they are used or returned.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a recommendation/ranking model (NCR, GRU4Rec, etc.), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
